entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: PreNeg_Intro_1
entries.dialogueText: The war council in Porte Drazon was buried beneath a flurry of urgent dispatches from the front. Artillery rumbled like distant thunder across the southern wire. The first phase of operations had reached its climax, and Wiktor Smolak had requested an urgent parley.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: PreNeg_Elena_BurnRate
entries.dialogueText: Your Majesty, the financial toll of this offensive is mounting rapidly. Daily ammunition consumption and fuel requisitions have pushed our operating budget to its limit. Whatever outcome we seek, we must conclude this war swiftly before fiscal exhaustion sets in.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: PreNeg_Lucita_Casualties
entries.dialogueText: Our soldiers have fought with unmatched courage, Sire. But Valdez's remaining garrisons are dug in behind fortified concrete. Pushing deeper into mainland Wehlen would turn into a meat grinder. Smolak is feeling the noose tighten; now is the moment to dictate terms.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: PreNeg_Laurento_Hotline
entries.dialogueText: Before you enter the negotiation tent or take Smolak's call, Your Majesty, the royal communications bureau has secured encrypted channels to three key foreign leaders. A final word with them could grant us invaluable diplomatic leverage.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Hotline_Hub_Prompt
entries.dialogueText: The secure teletype and telephone lines sat waiting in the royal communications cabinet. Who will you contact before meeting Smolak?

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Call_Alvarez
entries.dialogueText: Connect me with President Alvarez in Estord.
entries.menuText: Place an encrypted call to President Patricio Alvarez of Lespia.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Alvarez_Connect
entries.dialogueText: The line clicked and hissed before Alvarez's voice came through, punctuated by the clinking of ice against crystal and jazz playing faintly in the background.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Alvarez_Greeting
entries.dialogueText: Romus! Still holding the crown, I see? My staff tells me your artillery is giving my dear friend Wiktor a hell of a beating in Zille. I must admit, watching him sweat is the best entertainment I've had all season.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Alvarez_Prompt
entries.dialogueText: So, what brings the King of Rizia to my ear while his tanks are rolling?

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Alvarez_Ask_Troops
entries.dialogueText: Will Lespia deploy forces to assist us in breaking Smolak's remaining defenses?
entries.menuText: "Will Lespia commit ground divisions or airstrikes to help us finish off Wehlen?"

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Alvarez_Refuse_Troops
entries.dialogueText: Alvarez burst into loud, mocking laughter. "Send Lespian soldiers into Wehlen? What do you take me for, Romus, an amateur? If I put one boot across that border, Malenyev's submarines will blockade my coastline and Arcasia will hold me responsible for World War Three! No, no, no. Lespian boys don't die for your royal pride. You started this fightâyou finish it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Alvarez_Leverage
entries.dialogueText: Patricio, let us speak as realists. If Lespia does not provide high-altitude reconnaissance and guarantee a veto against CSP sanctions at the AN, I will sign an armistice with Smolak today. Wehlen will keep its army intact, and you will be left dealing with an enraged dictator on your frontier alone.
entries.menuText: "Patricio, if you won't provide intelligence and an AN veto, I will sign a ceasefire right now and leave Wehlen armed on your border."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Alvarez_Leverage_Yield
entries.dialogueText: A tense silence fell over the line. Alvarez sighed, the sound of ice swirling in his glass. "You drive a ruthless bargain, Your Majesty. Fine. My defense ministry will transmit our latest aerial reconnaissance photographs of Valdez's bunkers, and Lespian envoys in Kyrute will kill any resolution pushing for economic sanctions against Rizia. Just make sure Smolak is thoroughly humiliated before you put down the pen."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Alvarez_Hangup
entries.dialogueText: "Good luck, Romus. Don't make me regret this." The line went dead with a soft click.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Call_Hegel
entries.dialogueText: Connect me with Chancellor Hegel in Valgsland.
entries.menuText: Place an encrypted call to Chancellor Emmerich Hegel of Valgsland.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Hegel_Connect
entries.dialogueText: The line buzzed with heavy static. After two rings, Hegel's fiery voice boomed through the receiver.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Hegel_Rage
entries.dialogueText: Toras! Have you completely lost your royal mind? Bombarding cities, marching troops across borders, and playing feudal warlord right under the nose of the international community! The working people of South Merkopa are not pawns for your dynastic games!

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Hegel_Prompt
entries.dialogueText: Give me one good reason why the Red Fleet shouldn't steam into the Southern Gulf this very afternoon!

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Hegel_Sovereignty
entries.dialogueText: Chancellor Hegel, calm yourself. Wehlen occupied our territory unlawfully for thirty years. Rizia has no designs on mainland Wehlen, nor will we interfere with international shipping. We seek only our rightful borders.
entries.menuText: "Rizia is merely reclaiming stolen sovereign soil. We have no interest in mainland Wehlen or threatening maritime trade."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Hegel_Sovereignty_Reply
entries.dialogueText: A muffled thud echoed over the lineâHegel slamming his pipe against his desk. "Words are cheap, King! But if you keep your armor strictly on your side of the river and do not dare threaten commercial vessels in the straits, Valgsland will stay its hand. We have no love for Smolak's clownish brutality, but we will not tolerate imperialist conquest!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Hegel_Deescalation_Deal
entries.dialogueText: Let us be pragmatic, Chancellor. If the upcoming treaty guarantees demilitarized naval access in Zille waters and respects free trade, Rizia is prepared to conclude the fighting immediately. A stable South Merkopa benefits your trade routes.
entries.menuText: "If we conclude a swift treaty that guarantees naval demilitarization in Zille waters, can we establish stable relations?"

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Hegel_Deal_Reply
entries.dialogueText: Hegel grunted, his tone shifting from outrage to shrewd socialist calculation. "Now you are speaking like a statesman rather than a despot, Toras. If you guarantee naval demilitarization in the Zille gulf, Valgsland will discreetly authorize the export of modern coastal patrol escorts and fuel stabilization shipments to balance the region. Sign your treaty and withdraw your guns from the border!"

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Hegel_Hangup
entries.dialogueText: "Remember my words, Romus. We are watching you." The call terminated abruptly.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Call_Beatrice
entries.dialogueText: Patch me through to Thornbourgh. I wish to speak with Queen Beatrice.
entries.menuText: Place an encrypted call to Queen Beatrice Livingston of Rumburg.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Beatrice_Connect
entries.dialogueText: After a series of royal exchange operators verified the cipher, Beatrice's cool, aristocratic voice came over the speaker.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice_Greeting
entries.dialogueText: Romus. I trust you are calling with favorable dispatches from the south. The chancellery in Thornbourgh has been monitoring your military maneuvers with great interest.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice_Prompt
entries.dialogueText: How stands your campaign, Cousin?

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Beatrice_Report
entries.dialogueText: Our forces have shattered Wehzek resistance across the peninsula. Smolak has requested a parley, and we are preparing to dictate terms.
entries.menuText: "Our forces have broken Valdez's forward line. Smolak is ready to negotiate."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice_Report_Reply
entries.dialogueText: "Splendid news," Beatrice replied with measured warmth. "A monarch who demonstrates the will to wield the sword commands the respect of every crowned head in the world. Smolak is a dangerous radical; seeing him humbled brings stability to GRACE's southern flank."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Beatrice_Oil_Pledge
entries.dialogueText: Once the oil fields of Zille are back under royal control, the Crown is prepared to guarantee Rumburg long-term petroleum concessions at favorable rates, securing our economic revival.
entries.menuText: "Once Zille is secured, Rizia will guarantee Rumburg favorable oil contracts to assist our post-war recovery."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice_Oil_Reply
entries.dialogueText: "A mutually beneficial arrangement, Romus," she approved. "Rumburg will instruct our envoys to back Rizia unequivocally at the Alliance of Nations. Reclaim your birthright and restore order to the south. You have the full blessing of the Kingdom of Rumburg."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice_Hangup
entries.dialogueText: "Give my fondest regards to your mother. Stand firm, Romus." The queen ended the connection.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Proceed_To_Parley
entries.dialogueText: I have gathered all the diplomatic leverage I need. Have the escort preparedâI will meet Smolak face to face.
entries.menuText: "I have gathered all the diplomatic leverage I need. Have the car preparedâI will meet Smolak at the parley."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: PreNeg_Closing
entries.dialogueText: "The royal armored motorcade is standing by, Sire," Lucita reported, adjusting her sidearm. "The Golden Guard and our forward battalions will secure the perimeter. Let us settle this once and for all."
